Turbulence cannot be relied on for mixing at low Reynolds numbers because turbulent flows require higher velocities and larger length scales than those typically found in microfluidics. Additionally, turbulence can lead to unwanted side effects such as increased pressure drops and power consumption, which are undesirable in many microfluidic applications.
